_comment: Raw Phase 0 measurements, 2026-08-19. Every number here was produced by a command, not estimated. See ../findings.md for interpretation.
_provenance: All three graphify graphs were REBUILT from scratch after the sql/terraform extras were installed, so every number below comes from the environment documented in `environment` rather than from an earlier partial one. The testbed graph was byte-for-byte unchanged by that rebuild (2681 nodes / 5027 links before and after), which is expected: it contains no .sql or .tf files.

environment.leiden_clusterer: graspologic ABSENT - a fallback clusterer was in use for every measurement
environment.jdk: absent - the Java fixture was never compiled
environment.llm: none - no API key was set; every run used the deterministic AST path

graphify.files_indexed_note: 294 distinct source_file values, of which 2 ('next', 'postcss-load-config') are package pseudo-nodes harvested from package.json and are not files on disk
graphify.inferred_note: All 3 INFERRED links on this repo are lib/db-prisma.ts self-loops, so 0 file-level edges rest solely on an INFERRED link.

comparison_restricted_to_232_common_file.unrestricted_miss_is: the dangling components/providers.tsx -> components/accessibility, which is homegrown's own failure to resolve a barrel import. graphify resolves it correctly into two edges.
comparison_restricted_to_232_common_file.per_file_reverse_blast_radius_vs_homegro: across all 232 files: 220 identical, 12 larger, 0 smaller

homegrown.second_independent_defect: Removing 'scripts'/'docs'/'knowledge-base' from always_exclude_dirs raises the scan from 10 to 51 files but yields only ONE internal edge, and that one is dangling. Python sibling imports ('import behavior_graph') are classified 'external:', so the exclusion bug is necessary but far from sufficient to explain the zero.

graphify.inferred_note: 27 of the 42 are intra-file and invisible at file level. The 15 cross-file ones are all correct and are exactly freya's sys.path.insert cross-skill imports, every one of which homegrown reports as 'external:'.

comparison_restricted_to_10_common_files.note: Not a meaningful comparison. Homegrown produced no edges at all, so there was nothing to under-report against.

graphify.inferred_correctness: all 12 manually checked and correct; they are method calls whose receiver type had to be resolved from a declared type

9.1_under_reporting.evidence: 0 of 608 homegrown edges missing on the testbed; all 608 agreed edges independently backed by an import-family relation, so the agreement is not an artifact of folding symbol edges to file level

9.2_deletion_and_staleness.method: deleted a file, renamed a method, and removed an import in one update
9.2_deletion_and_staleness.evidence: nodes 40 -> 35; deleted file absent as a node source; stale symbol totalUnits gone; renamed sumUnits present; 0 dangling links
9.2_deletion_and_staleness.residual: one placeholder node 'inmemoryitemstore' with source_file:'' survives because AuditedItemStore.java:8 still says 'extends InMemoryItemStore'. Faithful to source, not stale. Distinguishable only by empty source_file.
9.2_deletion_and_staleness.force_guard: a 62% node drop (40 -> 15) proceeded without --force and without any guard message. The guard protects the curated/LLM layer, which is backed up separately, not code nodes.

9.3_reproducibility.method: graphify-out destroyed entirely between runs, so the SHA256 cache could not mask instability
9.3_reproducibility.large_repo: node and link sets identical; every link field identical; 6 of 2901 nodes differ in 'community' and 'community_name' only
9.3_reproducibility.caveat: measured with the fallback clusterer. graspologic/Leiden was not installed and may behave differently.

9.4_config_coverage.verdict: MIXED - and this refutes a premise in the spec
9.4_config_coverage.sql: works, but only after installing graphifyy[sql]. Extracts tables, views, foreign-key 'references' and view 'reads_from'. Warns clearly when the extra is missing.
9.4_config_coverage.terraform_hcl: works, but only after installing graphifyy[terraform]. Resolved an interpolation dependency (cloudfront -> s3 bucket) correctly. Warns clearly when missing.
9.4_config_coverage.yaml: NOT SUPPORTED. k8s manifests and docker-compose produced zero nodes AND zero warnings.
9.4_config_coverage.json: manifest-aware only. package.json produced 5 nodes; generic data JSON produced nothing.

9.5_degradation_and_output_location.output_location: writes only to graphify-out/. knowledge-base/.graph/ was untouched in both repos.
9.5_degradation_and_output_location.adr_017_trigger: does NOT fire. behavior.json does not need to move.
9.5_degradation_and_output_location.absence: exit code 127, clearly detectable; the homegrown resolver is unaffected with graphify off PATH.
